text: [S1] So, how have you been feeling since our last session? [S2] I don't know, I just... I keep having the same dream again. I'm back in the house, and I can hear him coming up the stairs, and I just freeze. I can't move, I can't scream, I just... I'm just a kid again. [S1] That sounds really overwhelming. [S2] It is. And then I wake up and my heart's going crazy and I don't even know where I am for like a full minute. My wife tries to help but I just push her away, I don't mean to, it just happens. I hate it. I hate that he still does this to me and he's not even here anymore.
